name: ctx
description: Fast local search and 'git blame' for agent sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Fast local search and 'git blame' for agent sessions.
interface.longDescription: ctx provides fast local search across messages and tool calls in your past agent sessions. ctx pro is a paid add-on that traces a line, file, commit, or PR back to the original agent session that produced it.
defaultPrompt: Search my past agent sessions for context relevant to this task.
Use ctx pro to find the agent session that produced this code.
